args.note: I've written cold-read.md. No issue markers reached me, so I split the book where it changes city: Keel 1–27, Halyard 28–41, Oasis 42–65. Keel pulled me in, mainly the p2 debt screen, Bi11bot and Tomas. I nearly put it down at the p14 lecture on the three objects. Halyard reads as if balloons are missing: Lock never speaks and Alex's questions on pp29 and 34 get no answers. Oasis got to me with Adrian's death (pp55–56) and "That's the problem" (p57), but then lost me in the council pages (50–53, 61–63). Characters I couldn't keep apart: Mara and Mera, Lina, Leona and Ada Veyra, Tomas and Tomas Reed. TJ shows up on p64 with no introduction. Never resolved: Alex's debt and whether he went back for Grandma.

args.note: Cold read B complete: read all 65 pages as assigned homework, split into three issues at the city breaks; strongest pulls were the birthday debt (p2), the 62/18 reveal (p24), the mother reveal (p43) and Adrian's death (pp55–56); biggest leaks were the pp13–15 lecture, the frictionless refusals, and TJ appearing from nowhere on p64.
